description: Eversource Energy, headquartered in Boston, Massachusetts and Hartford, Connecticut, is a public utility holding company subject to regulation by the Federal Energy Regulatory Commission under the Public Utility Holding Company Act of 2005, engaged primarily in the energy delivery business through its wholly-owned utility subsidiaries: The Connecticut Light and Power Company, a regulated electric utility serving residential, commercial and industrial customers in parts of Connecticut; NSTAR Electric Company, a regulated electric utility serving residential, commercial and industrial customers in parts of eastern and western Massachusetts that owns solar power facilities, and its wholly-owned subsidiary Harbor Electric Energy Company; Public Service Company of New Hampshire; and other subsidiaries.
